# Latvian Institute of International Affairs (LIIA)

> Latvia's leading think tank for research on international affairs, geopolitics, foreign policy, and regional security analysis.

LIIA is a prominent research institution based in Riga that publishes policy briefs, yearbooks, and expert commentary on European affairs, Baltic security, and global geopolitical developments. The institute hosts public events, maintains research fellows, and operates specialized programmes focused on Asia, EU, and Middle East policy.

## Key Topics

- geopolitics
- foreign policy
- international affairs
- Baltic region
- security policy
- think tank
- policy analysis
- Latvia
- European Union
- China
- Belarus
- Lithuania
- Taiwan
- regional analysis
- international relations

## Research & Publications

- [Publications](https://liia.lv/en/publications): LIIA research publications, briefs, and yearbooks on regional geopolitics
- [Latvian Foreign and Security Policy. Yearbook 2026](https://liia.lv/en/publications/latvian-foreign-and-security-policy-yearbook-2026-1492): LIIA yearbook on Latvia's foreign and security policy for 2026
- [The Nordic-Baltic Eight Institute Series of Topical Briefs](https://liia.lv/en/publications/the-nordic-baltic-eight-institute-series-of-topical-briefs-1554): Nordic-Baltic Eight policy brief series on regional security and geopolitics
- [Quo Vadis, Belarus? Perspectives from the Belarus Research Network on Neighborhood Policy](https://liia.lv/en/publications/quo-vadis-belarus-perspectives-from-the-belarus-research-network-on-neighborhood-policy-1530): Belarus Research Network analysis on EU neighborhood policy toward Belarus
- [Pasaule nav mainījusies, tā vienmēr tāda ir bijusi](https://liia.lv/en/publications/pasaule-nav-mainijusies-ta-vienmer-tada-ir-bijusi-1545): Analysis of world order changes and geopolitical shifts in international relations

- [News](https://liia.lv/en/news): LIIA news and events on foreign policy, security, and geopolitics

## Expert Commentary

- [Opinions](https://liia.lv/en/opinions): Expert commentary and opinion articles on international affairs and geopolitics
- [Lietuva gatava uzlabot attiecības ar Ķīnu. Kā tas ietekmēs nākotnes attiecības ar Taivānu? / @LSM.lv](https://liia.lv/en/opinions/lietuva-gatava-uzlabot-attiecibas-ar-kinu-ka-tas-ietekmes-nakotnes-attiecibas-ar-taivanu-lsm-lv-1557): Expert analysis on Lithuania-China relations and Taiwan diplomacy implications
- ["Spried ar Delfi": Kā attīstīsies karadarbība Tuvajos Austrumos / @Delfi](https://liia.lv/en/opinions/spried-ar-delfi-ka-attistisies-karadarbiba-tuvajos-austrumos-delfi-1552): Expert commentary on Middle East conflict developments and warfare analysis
- [(ne)Diplomātiskas pusdienas: Valsts nosaukuma maiņa: leģitimizācija jaunai politiskai un sociālai struktūra / @LR1](https://liia.lv/en/opinions/nediplomatiskas-pusdienas-valsts-nosaukuma-maina-legitimizacija-jaunai-politiskai-un-socialai-struktura-lr1-1556): Radio broadcast on state name changes and political legitimacy in geopolitics
